events: Deep inside the house of mirrors
Through the blur and haze of all our days
Bore in our fear and in our minds
Or in the trenches of our kind
I lurked in eigengrau and pined
For when I taste your praise divine
And all the other thoughts that I couldn't concede
Why can't I stack up to you?
And why are the skies not the shade of blue
For when it all turns to dust
We can cut through the crowds, hereby saying:
Hey, check out my dope flow
Can't live up to yours, though
I don't mean to hit low
So, is this the way you fought them?
Tell me, is this how you brought them
Oh, such a feeble way you taught them
It won't change my true objective
View our form, how you reject it
No point trying to correct it
Best I take a new direction
Unlike those who try to hurt you
I'm a beast of my own virtue!
Some would say that we were weaker
Just a little, feeble glimpse of what's in store
Now I can see that it's true
By all the actions you do
Out to sea, where tides are shifting
Made our marks on this plane
Made the silence fear our name
Can't even dare complain, 'cuz I know
We'd do anything to cling onto our reign
I know we're just the same
Yet I can't see the line drawn in the sand
Every step I take, I'm damned
With the pow'r, yet here we stand
Says the liar of the land
The scar on the mountain of my marks
Saved the face, still, it drilled into my heart

So hold on tight, for there's no fighting the past
Now I won't forget, till the flame
that I cast is set ablaze!
Every moment that has brought us to this
Help me carry on, for my own remiss

The world spins on, and it spins to despair,
but you still know I'll be there

the tears just cloud the things
ALL, JUST FOR NOTHING AT ALL
WILL I STILL BE HERE STANDING TALL
I'VE GOT A PATH TO TREAD,
BUT OF ONE THING I AM CERTAIN
